name: openpaperwork-finance
description: Finance: invoices and credit notes with the file each country takes (Factur-X / ZUGFeRD and XRechnung for Germany and France; Peppol BIS 3 for Norway, Denmark, Finland, the UK, Belgium, the Netherlands (or SI-UBL), Austria (or ebInterface) and Ireland; Facturae for Spain, FatturaPA for Italy, the KSeF invoice for Poland), tax invoices for Australia, Canada and the US, and a smaller Swedish company's annual report (K2), each with its scripted check.
